= IKE Platform — Third-Party Notices
:icons: font
:source-highlighter: coderay
:toc: preamble
:toclevels: 3

This page is the curated companion to two mechanical inventories
that ship alongside it:

* link:bom.json[Software Bill of Materials (CycloneDX, JSON)] —
  full transitive dependency graph with SPDX-normalized licenses
  and artifact hashes. Ingestible by Dependency-Track, Trivy,
  Snyk, GitHub's dependency graph, etc. Also reachable as a Maven
  artifact with `<classifier>cyclonedx</classifier>`.
* link:dependencies.html[Maven dependencies report] — auto-generated
  HTML browse of declared dependencies, with verbatim per-license
  text from each dependency's POM.

The curated content below covers what neither sees — the language
toolchain, BOM-managed dependency families, signing engine, and
runtime libraries consumers pick up indirectly through `ike-parent`
or `ike-bom`. License identifiers below are SPDX form (`Apache-2.0`,
`MIT`, `EPL-2.0`, expressions with `OR` / `AND` / `WITH`) so they're
unambiguous and grep-friendly.

For corresponding notices in the rest of the IKE platform see:

* `link:../ike-tooling/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.html[ike-tooling]` — Maven
  build infrastructure, plugin core, signing.
* `link:../ike-docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.html[ike-docs]` — AsciiDoc
  rendering chain, fonts, DocBook, frontend assets.

== Java language and runtime

|===
| Component | License | Role

| https://openjdk.org/[OpenJDK 25]
| `GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0`
| The Java SDK and runtime targeted by IKE consumers. Build uses
  `--enable-preview` for opt-in language preview features. The
  Classpath Exception is what makes OpenJDK usable from non-GPL
  consumers without infecting their licensing.
|===

== Maven build infrastructure (consumed by ike-parent)

|===
| Component | License | Role

| https://maven.apache.org/[Apache Maven] core
| `Apache-2.0`
| Build orchestration. `ike-parent` is a Maven 4 (modelVersion 4.1.0)
  POM consumed by every project that wants IKE conventions.

| https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-site-plugin/[Maven Site Plugin],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-project-info-reports-plugin/[Maven Project Info Reports Plugin]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Site rendering and project reports.

| https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-dependency-plugin/[Maven Dependency Plugin]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Used by `ike-parent` to unpack the `site-theme`, `asciidoctorconfig`,
  and font classified artifacts at build phases.

| https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-compiler-plugin/[Compiler],
  https://maven.apache.org/surefire/maven-surefire-plugin/[Surefire],
  https://maven.apache.org/surefire/maven-failsafe-plugin/[Failsafe],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-jar-plugin/[Jar],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-resources-plugin/[Resources],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-install-plugin/[Install],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-deploy-plugin/[Deploy],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-clean-plugin/[Clean]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Standard Maven lifecycle plugins, version-pinned in
  `ike-parent` pluginManagement so consumers inherit consistent
  versions.

| https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-source-plugin/[Source],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-javadoc-plugin/[Javadoc],
  https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-gpg-plugin/[GPG]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Source jar, javadoc, and (with the BC signer) signing during release.

| https://www.bouncycastle.org/[Bouncy Castle (`bcprov-jdk18on`, `bcpg-jdk18on`)]
| `MIT` (Bouncy Castle distributes under an MIT-X11 adaptation; SPDX classifies as `MIT`)
| OpenPGP signing engine activated via `<signer>bc</signer>` on
  `maven-gpg-plugin`. Required because the native `gpg` signer
  serializes through `gpg-agent` and breaks parallel reactor builds.
|===

== Java annotation processing and bytecode

|===
| Component | License | Role

| https://asm.ow2.io/[ASM 9.x]
| `BSD-3-Clause`
| Bytecode manipulation library. Pinned at the version compatible
  with the `--release 25` compiler target so annotation processors
  on the build classpath don't fail on newer class file versions.

| https://www.lombok.org/[Project Lombok] (consumer-optional)
| `MIT`
| Annotation processor for boilerplate reduction. `ike-bom` manages
  the version; consumers opt in.
|===

== Logging, JSON, and runtime utilities (BOM-managed)

These dependencies are version-managed by `ike-bom` for consumers
that import the BOM. `ike-platform` itself does not add them as
direct compile dependencies.

|===
| Component | License | Role

| https://www.slf4j.org/[SLF4J API]
| `MIT`
| Logging facade.

| https://logback.qos.ch/[Logback Classic / Core]
| `EPL-1.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later`
| Default SLF4J implementation.

| https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson[Jackson] (`jackson-core`,
  `jackson-databind`, `jackson-annotations`, `jackson-datatype-jsr310`,
  `jackson-dataformat-yaml`)
| `Apache-2.0`
| JSON / YAML serialization stack.

| https://www.snakeyaml.org/[SnakeYAML]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Underlying YAML parser used by Jackson YAML datatype.

| https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-lang/[Apache Commons Lang],
  https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-io/[Commons IO]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Standard utility libraries surfaced through the BOM.

| https://github.com/google/guava[Guava]
| `Apache-2.0`
| Collections and concurrency utilities, BOM-managed.
|===

== AsciiDoc and Maven Site (consumed by ike-parent for project reports)

`ike-parent` activates the AsciiDoc pipeline through profiles when
a consumer's module has `src/docs/asciidoc/` or `src/site/asciidoc/`.
The toolchain itself lives in `ike-docs` (see that reactor's
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES) — the components reachable through the
`ike-parent` consumer chain are summarized here for visibility:

* AsciidoctorJ (`MIT`)
* AsciidoctorJ PDF / Diagram (`MIT`)
* JRuby (`EPL-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR LGPL-2.1-only`)
* Asciidoctor Maven Plugin (`MIT`)
* Asciidoctor Parser Doxia Module (`MIT`)
* https://github.com/sentrysoftware/maven-skins[Sentry Maven Skin] (`Apache-2.0`) — the Maven Site skin every published page uses.
* https://prismjs.com/[Prism] (`MIT`) — syntax highlighter in rendered HTML.
* https://fontawesome.com/[Font Awesome] free tier — `CC-BY-4.0 AND OFL-1.1 AND MIT` (different files, different licenses).

For full per-component detail (versions, links, role notes), see
the `link:../ike-docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.html[ike-docs notices]`.

== Verification

* `mvn package` produces `target/bom.json` and `target/bom.xml`
  (CycloneDX 1.6 format) with SPDX-normalized licenses.
* `mvn site` populates `target/site/licenses.html`,
  `target/site/dependencies.html`, `target/site/plugins.html`,
  `target/site/plugin-management.html`, and
  `target/site/dependency-management.html` from declared
  `<dependencies>`, `<build><plugins>`, `<build><pluginManagement>`,
  and `<dependencyManagement>` (the last surfaces BOM-managed entries).
* The same `mvn site` run copies `bom.json` and `bom.xml` into
  `target/site/` so they're reachable from the published Maven Site.
* This curated document complements those mechanical inventories
  for the language toolchain, signing engine, and runtime libraries
  that consumers pick up indirectly.
